seo_contract.structured_data: IA eligibility only; must match visible content

performance_contract.image_contract: AVIF + WebP fallback; explicit dimensions; responsive srcset

cases.name: Exact bilingual Website route inventory and initial HTML
cases.oracle: All 26 IA §3.1 Website Route IDs exist only at approved English and zh-CN paths; canonical index pages contain primary content in raw HTML; no invented aliases.

cases.name: META-WEB content registry and ownership
cases.oracle: Every publishable Website record has required META-WEB ownership, locale, canonical and translation data with deterministic identity.

cases.name: CAN-WEB normalization and query exclusion
cases.oracle: Self-canonical URLs use normalized localized paths; query/tracking/filter inputs never create canonicals; no canonical chain.

cases.name: ALT-WEB reciprocal hreflang and x-default
cases.oracle: en and zh-CN alternates are reciprocal only for published 200 peers; English canonical is x-default; no fake alternates.

cases.name: Website HTTP semantics and soft-404 prevention
cases.oracle: Known pages use contractual status; unknown is 404; withdrawn guide/legal is 410 where specified; superseded legal redirect is intentional; no 200 soft 404.

cases.name: Index policy and Website sitemap authority
cases.oracle: Only canonical indexable 200 Website URLs enter Website sitemap; private/Auth/Workspace/Admin/UGC/error URLs are absent; lastmod is content-owned.

cases.name: Released-capability claim gating
cases.oracle: Website claims only signed/integrated P05-P18 capabilities; deferred/unreleased capabilities are not promoted; no fake Dashboard/product UI.

cases.name: Home content and partial-data states
cases.oracle: WEB-HOME represents real product tasks and truthful announcement/pricing/maintenance partial states.

cases.name: Product-family factual parity
cases.oracle: Product pages describe only signed capability behavior and preserve security, entitlement, malware and risk boundaries.

cases.name: Solution workflow factual parity
cases.oracle: Solution pages map to real signed workflows without fabricated outcomes, customer counts, ratings or endorsements.

cases.name: Developers and Docs acquisition boundary
cases.oracle: Developer Website routes link only released API capabilities and P18 Docs canonical routes; unreleased methods are not acquisition targets.

cases.name: Pricing truth and failure states
cases.oracle: Pricing uses reviewed plan/quota/entitlement fields, never fabricates price/availability, and handles data-unavailable/maintenance truthfully.

cases.name: Security claims evidence boundary
cases.oracle: Security copy is grounded in signed Auth/Risk/Files/ClamAV/Domain/Abuse authority; no unverified compliance/certification or absolute-security claims.

cases.name: Guide publication lifecycle
cases.oracle: Guide manifest is deterministic; published pages reachable; withdrawn 410; unknown 404; translation peers are never fabricated.

cases.name: About and legal versioned content
cases.oracle: About/Terms/Privacy/AUP/Abuse use reviewed versioned content and contractual superseded/withdrawn behavior.

cases.name: Contact conversion flow inheritance
cases.oracle: WEB-CONTACT preserves P14/P15/P17 contact, Turnstile, rate and secret-safety authority with all required persistent states.

cases.name: Internal-link graph and orphan prevention
cases.oracle: Every indexable Website page is crawlably reachable from approved parents; zero indexable orphans/broken parent edges/fake locale links.

cases.name: JSON-LD eligibility and validation
cases.oracle: Structured data is only IA-eligible, matches visible content, validates and contains no fabricated ratings/reviews/offers.

cases.name: Social cards and asset attribution
cases.oracle: OpenGraph/Twitter assets are deterministic, correctly dimensioned, locally controlled/attributed, non-broken and metadata-consistent.

cases.name: Robots and crawler policy parity
cases.oracle: Crawler policy keeps canonical Website crawlable, private/UGC acquisition excluded, and matches sitemap/index policy.

cases.name: Raw HTML and crawler/render parity
cases.oracle: Primary content, metadata, canonical, hreflang and eligible JSON-LD exist without client execution; no crawler-only differential rendering.

cases.name: Broken-link and static-asset integrity
cases.oracle: Internal links and href/src/srcset assets resolve; no broken canonical, hreflang, social-card or navigation targets.

cases.name: Desktop browser route and conversion matrix
cases.oracle: Representative Website families render real content, navigation, CTA and required error/partial states in a real browser with no placeholder UI.

cases.name: Responsive and 320 CSS px reflow matrix
cases.oracle: Desktop/tablet/mobile/320 CSS px pass without clipped controls, overlap, horizontal content loss or hover-only actions.

cases.name: Accessibility semantic and interaction matrix
cases.oracle: Keyboard order, visible focus, landmarks/headings, names/roles/values, reduced motion, image alternatives and persistent statuses pass.

cases.name: Design System visual conformance
cases.oracle: Website templates conform to Design System §§1-14 and IA §16 screenshot matrix; no placeholder icon, random illustration, broken image or uncontrolled motion.

cases.name: Website bundle isolation and initial JS budget
cases.oracle: Initial JS <=150 KB gzip; Website does not load Workspace/Admin bundles; route splitting remains effective.

cases.name: CWV image font and cache budgets
cases.oracle: Frozen lab profile proves LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1; principal images/fonts/cache satisfy Master performance contract.

cases.name: Static Website production runtime boundary
cases.oracle: Website is pre-rendered/static through Nginx; production Node HTTP/SSR/PM2 and Docker/Compose remain prohibited; no crawler-only runtime path.

cases.name: Deterministic Website manifest and bilingual parity ledger
cases.oracle: Two clean builds produce equivalent publishable manifest/SEO inventory with explicit locale parity and stable source digests.

cases.name: Exact-head evidence coherence
cases.oracle: T001-T030 is complete, secret-safe, digest-bound and same-head; inherited P18/public capability authority is live-bound; mixed/stale/malformed evidence fails closed.

cases.name: Accountable exact-head closure
cases.oracle: Closure binds T001-T031, applicable regression, P19 G4/G5/G7/G8/G9 and defects 0/0/0; only a review-only signed child may become merge-authoritative.
